_comment: PDK pin for this repo's benches (issue #4, T1 item 9). Consumed by sim/env.sh (revision check) and sim/smoke/run_smoke.sh (model files, OSDI objects). The pin value is the SG13CMOS5L target pin that 2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json carries (same commit and tarball sha256); this repo adds the first runtime evidence for it: sim/smoke/records/. Pin bumps need a decision record under sim/ENV-DECISION.md or spec/.
variant_of_checkout: combined IHP-Open-PDK checkout: PDK_ROOT must hold BOTH ihp-sg13g2/ and ihp-sg13cmos5l/ (the shared MOS, pnpMPA-adjacent and resistor corner files are relative symlinks into ../ihp-sg13g2)
revision_kind: commit (no IHP-Open-PDK release tag ships ihp-sg13cmos5l; v0.3.0 has no such directory)
tarball_sha256_note: copied from sg13g2-bandgap sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json; the tarball was not re-hashed here. The revision itself was verified by git (rev-parse HEAD of the checkout used for the smoke record).
install_method: direct git checkout: git init; git fetch --depth 1 origin <revision>; git checkout FETCH_HEAD (equivalently git clone --branch dev then checkout the revision). Not open_pdks/ciel: neither ships ihp-sg13cmos5l at this pin.
revision_probe: git -C $PDK_ROOT rev-parse HEAD, or the first line of $PDK_ROOT/.pdk-revision when the install has no .git

model_files_verification.pdk_tree: fleet PDK store bundle at PDK_ROOT=~/share/pdk; ihp-sg13cmos5l/.pdk-store.json reports version f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14, so sim/env.sh accepts it (issue #21)
model_files_verification.result: 12/12 required sections found, 0 problems, exit 0. Every spec/target-spec.md §PVT section name resolves verbatim at the pin; no rename.
model_files_verification.negative_control: cornerPNP.lib copied to a scratch dir with its .LIB stat block deleted, then --models-dir pointed at that copy: exit 1, 11/12, 'ERROR: cornerPNP.lib section stat not defined'.
model_files_verification.smoke: sim/smoke/run_smoke.sh passes at this pin with ngspice-47; record sim/smoke/records/20261113T095737Z-66c149b.json.
model_files_verification.real_file_note: real_file is true for every entry as the fleet PDK store delivers the tree: the bundle materializes the shared files that an upstream combined git checkout at this pin carries as relative symlinks into ../ihp-sg13g2 (see variant_of_checkout). That materialization is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the store's sibling ihp-sg13g2 tree is pinned at v0.3.0, NOT at this dev commit, and cornerRES.lib, sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib and resistors_mod.lib differ in content between the two trees, so live symlinks would resolve cm5 models to v0.3.0 content. A host installing a raw combined git checkout instead sees these as symlinks (real_file false) into whatever revision its own ihp-sg13g2 holds.
model_files_verification.mismatch_sections: Informational, not required by the checker, all present at the pin: cornerMOShv.lib mos_tt_stat and mos_{tt,ss,ff,sf,fs}_mismatch; cornerRES.lib res_stat, res_stat_mismatch and res_{typ,bcs,wcs}_mismatch. Which of these the Monte Carlo benches use is not decided here.

osdi.build_step: sim/README.md 'OSDI build': sg13g2-bandgap sim/tools/build-osdi.sh at the commit pinned in reuse.lock.json builds psp103, psp103_nqs, r3_cmc and mosvar from the PDK's Verilog-A with a checksum-pinned openvaf-r. cap_cmomi.osdi and cap_cmomf.osdi (MoM capacitors) are NOT built by it and are not exercised by the smoke bench; a bench that needs them needs a build step added first.

simulator.observed_bad: 42 (Ubuntu 24.04 apt): 'NGSPICE only supports OSDI v0.3 but psp103.osdi targets v0.4' -- the pinned openvaf-r emits OSDI v0.4, so psp103 never loads and every MOS fails with 'could not find a valid modelname'
